prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE transparent pixel-art downward lightning bolt for a tactical RPG spell animation, a production bitmap sprite. Tall narrow composition, full bolt complete. A single continuous powerful white-blue zigzag stroke drops vertically from top to bottom; thick sharp icy-white core, pale periwinkle blue edge, muted blue-violet outer pixel edge. NO branching anywhere yet; this is the descending strike BEFORE its later ground-impact and branching stages. The trunk should read as fast heavy downward force, with a pointed tip at its bottom. Coarse crisp pixel clusters, limited 4-color ramp (#eef2f1 core, #b5c9e4 pale edge, #898cca violet-blue, #566ca4 blue shade). Same matte soft blue-purple fantasy pixel style; vivid readable white core, no photographic glow, no gradients, no airbrush, no particle cloud, no antialiasing fuzz. One slender bolt only, centered on a genuinely transparent background; no text, no weapon, no character, no frame, no floor, no impact explosion yet. Plenty of clear transparent margins on all sides, complete endpoints.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a 3 columns x 2 rows sprite sheet of SIX consecutive pixel-art lightning GROUND IMPACT effects for a tactical RPG, genuine transparent background. Each of six cells has the same fixed center and same fixed ground baseline, generous transparent gutters, complete effect shapes. Order left-to-right top row then bottom row. Every frame is a low wide effect on a horizontal ground plane seen in game side view, no actual painted floor or background. Phase 0: instant hard strike at a single central ground point, a bright compressed white-blue burst and short sharp impact crown, NO branched lightning yet. Phase 1: strong explosive ground shock, broad flattened white-blue impact flare, upward angular dust/spark plumes and a forceful outward oval pressure ring, NO branched lightning yet. Phase 2: the pressure ring expands to both sides and chunks/sparks kick upward, central flash begins to weaken, still NO branching lightning. Phase 3: AFTER the ground shock, several sharp branching blue-purple electric arcs begin to split outward from the impact point and crawl over the ground; pressure ring is already fading. Phase 4: branched arcs split into smaller outward electric fragments, darker remnants of impact spray underneath. Phase 5: a few small residual white-blue spark fragments fade, no big column or persistent crater. Emphasize the temporal order: first physically forceful ground IMPACT, only LATER electrical branching. The six states are clearly distinct animation phases, not six identical explosions. Palette limited to icy white #eef2f1, pale blue #b5c9e4, periwinkle #898cca, subdued deep blue #566ca4; a few cool slate dust pixels are allowed. Crisp coarse pixel clusters, restrained soft blue-violet style, high contrast bright center, no red, yellow or orange fire. No large vertical sky bolt (it is a separate sprite), no circular magical rune, no character, no text, no labels, no outlines around cells, no backgrounds, no soft blur or glow halo. All debris and sparks complete inside each cell.
